notes.title: Little Library Patch Notes — Update v1.0.3 📢
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I’ve been listening to your feedback and working hard on fixing some of the most persistent bugs in Little Library. This patch focuses on tightening up the daily flow and eliminating a few issues that have been bugging people for a while. Here’s what’s included:

🧹 Philosophy Shelf – Now Dustable!
Yes, it was real. Yes, it was annoying. The Philosophy shelf can now be dusted like every other shelf in the library. The issue is fully fixed. Dust to your heart’s content.

📚 Infinite Shelving Glitch – Fixed
That eternal shelving loop is gone. The game now includes persistent checks that track the number of returned books shelved. Once you’ve done the job, the task ends. No more shelving into the void.

🔁 Daily Reset Stability
I’ve added backup logic to ensure that each new day starts clean. Tasks from the previous day will no longer bleed into the next—no leftover objectives, no confusion, just a fresh start every morning.

Thank you to everyone who’s playing Little Library, and especially to those of you who’ve taken the time to report bugs. Your feedback makes a real difference, and I appreciate it.

If you run into anything else, please let me know!

notes.title: 📢 Little Library Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A new patch is rolling out and should be live within 24 hours! Here’s what’s included:

    🛠️ Fixed an issue where the game didn’t recognize when books had been shelved.

    🧹 Fixed an issue where the game didn’t recognize when shelves had been dusted.

    🎮 Added key re-binding support for both keyboard and gamepad.

    🕹️ Players can now use WASD keys to move!

    💻 The new key re-binding and gamepad support should make the game compatible with Steam Deck.

Thanks for playing Little Library! Your feedback helps me make the game better with every update.

notes.title: Major Updates!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I’m thrilled to finally properly introduce Little Library, a cozy library-management and life-sim game set in the charming village of Maplewood. You’ll be in charge of a brand-new library, growing it into a thriving community hub while forming friendships, exploring the village, and uncovering its history.

Since development began, the game has grown far beyond the library walls. Now, in addition to organizing books and managing the collection, you’ll also be able to farm, fish, and explore the mysterious Whispering Woods. In this devlog, I’ll take you through some of the game’s core mechanics and recent updates that have helped shape Little Library into the cozy and immersive experience it’s meant to be!

[b]Building the Library: A Place for the Community[/b]

At the heart of Little Library is, of course, the library itself. When you arrive in Maplewood, the library is lifeless. You’ll be responsible for expanding its collection, organizing displays, hosting events, and earning a reputation to make it a true community space.

[b]Growing the Collection[/b]

📚 [b]Over 70 books to collect[/b] – Find, purchase, or earn books to build out the library’s shelves. Some books are rare or collectible, increasing the library’s reputation when displayed!
📖 [b]Recommend books to villagers[/b] – Each villager has unique reading interests, and matching them with the right book will help the library’s reputation.
🗺️ [b]Expand the Local History section[/b] – Uncover forgotten stories from Maplewood’s past as you collect books about the village’s history.

[b]New Ways to Experience Village Life[/b]

While running the library is your primary job, there’s more to life in Maplewood than books! The village is full of opportunities to unwind, explore, and connect with the locals.

[b]Farming: Grow Crops to Support Yourself 🌾[/b]

To make ends meet, you can plant and harvest crops right outside your home. Whether you grow vegetables for extra income or share them with the community, farming adds a peaceful and rewarding element to your village life.

[b]Fishing: Cast Your Line in the Local Waters 🎣[/b]

The rivers and ponds around Maplewood are teeming with fish! Fishing is a great way to earn money, complete villager requests, and relax after a long day of running the library. Who knows—you might even find some hidden treasures along the way!

[b]The Whispering Woods: A Mysterious Forest Awaits 🌲[/b]

Just beyond the village lies the Whispering Woods, a dense and quiet forest shrouded in mystery. As you explore, you may discover hidden items, rare books, or even secrets about Maplewood’s past. But be careful—some say the woods hold stories best left forgotten…

[b]Dynamic Villagers and Schedules[/b]

The villagers of Maplewood each have their own daily routines, moving around the village instead of staying in one spot. Whether they’re visiting the library, shopping, or fishing by the river, you’ll see them going about their lives, making the world feel vibrant and alive.

[b]More Realistic Library Visitors[/b]

Instead of standing in one place, library patrons now browse the shelves and move between sections, making the library feel more like a real, functioning space. NPCs also have a wider range of dialogue, making interactions more varied and rewarding.

[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]

Since early testing, I’ve made several improvements to make the game feel smoother and more enjoyable:

✅ [b]Clearer communication:[/b] Item costs are now clearly stated and notifications introduce important mechanics at the right time.
✅ [b]End-of-day summaries:[/b] Each night, you’ll receive a progress update showing how much the library’s reputation has grown and how your relationships with villagers have changed.
✅ [b]Mini-game improvements:[/b] Visual indicators now guide you in cleaning shelves and restocking books, making tasks easier to complete.
✅ [b]Bug fixes:[/b] Various freezing issues, incorrect floor-spot tracking, and disappearing characters during mini-games have been resolved!

[b]Looking Ahead[/b]

If you’re excited about Little Library, let me know your thoughts in the comments. Don’t forget to wishlist the game to stay updated on future developments, updates on the [b]demo release[/b], and a [b]release date for the game[/b]! Both will be here sooner than you know it.

Until next time, happy reading—and happy playing! 📚🎣🌿
